title: Commit-to-published latency is poll-bound; the watch plane exists but nothing registers it for publication
wanted_capability: Event-driven publication for checkout-owner lanes: a commit to a published ref should reach the accepted publication in seconds, not a collector poll interval. Today the loop is poll-shaped end to end: the collector wakes on interval_secs (was 900, now 120 on this host), uploads a candidate, the auto-advance grant accepts it, and the edge-index warms. Meanwhile bbox_project_publisher_status already reports watcher_running: true with the base attachment listed under capable_but_unregistered and artifact_watching among its capabilities, so the daemon-side watch plane exists and nothing registers checkout attachments for commit-triggered publication. Wanted: (1) the collector (or the attachment watcher) subscribes to ref updates on registered checkouts (post-commit hook, fs event on .git refs, or daemon-pushed nudge) and runs the publish for exactly the affected project immediately; (2) the acceptance-to-served tail shrinks: the post-acceptance complete-graph-view rebuild currently defers on large sidecar graphs (edge-index watcher "deferred a store-only nudge" at 1.4M edges) or answers error.edge_index_warming for minutes, so incremental application of a single accepted generation's delta is the companion piece. Poll stays as the reconciliation backstop, events become the fast path.
missing_primitive: ref-update-triggered publish on checkout attachments (watcher registration) plus incremental post-acceptance view application
fallback_used: Dropped this host's collector interval_secs from 900 to 120 (cycles are ~200ms no-ops when current, so faster polling is nearly free); auto-advance grants remove the manual acceptance wait; own-visibility workspace captures already give sub-second iteration for the authoring checkout.
evidence: crates/bbox-code-collector/src/main.rs run_published_knowledge_lane: timer loop on interval_secs (default_interval_secs = 120, +-10% jitter), backoff to 15 min on whole-lane failure
crates/bbox-code-source/src/lib.rs ProducerCommandV1: only kind=enroll, no publish-now command
src/server/checkout_access.rs catalog_watch_carriers skips cutover-covered projects; collector-owned attachments always report capable_but_unregistered
src/server/state.rs watcher_runtime_view; src/tools/project_catalog.rs publisher_health_summary watcher block
src/server/background.rs start_bbox_watcher reacts only to local .bbox/knowledge and .bbox/gaps changes, not .git refs
src/server/knowledge_view.rs refresh_published_graph_views: post-acceptance graph view is rebuilt per project synchronously; edge_index_warming is the separate EdgeIndex watcher (issue #44)
notes: Triage trace at a66c6813: still relevant for the commit-to-candidate half; only the collector timer triggers publication. Correction to the record: the post-acceptance tail for knowledge, gaps and the published graph view is applied synchronously per project on accept; the edge_index_warming / store-only nudge deferral belongs to the code EdgeIndex watcher, which the accept path does not nudge and which is tracked by issue #44.
